headline: Dazhong Holdings hits four consecutive limit-ups, up 46% in a swing! Loses NT$0.08 per share in August - Liberty Finance
summary: Dazhong Holdings (3701) hit the limit-up price of NT$60.9 for a fourth consecutive session, a range gain of 45.86%. Closing limit-up buy orders of 6,334 lots went unfilled.
why: Limit-up moves are daily price caps on Taiwan-listed stocks, and sharp swings in small caps often reflect concentrated trading. The company is listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange.
why_moved: The report describes four consecutive limit-up sessions with large unfilled buy orders at the close. It gives no specific cause for the move.
